data.narrative:
Alpine Eagle is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Jan-Hendrik Boelens and Timo Breuer, having raised €10.25M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning both public equities (2 companies: DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and private capital (8 companies including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic), with private valuations ranging from $125M to $4.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier to the €10.25M raised proxy, implying a $26M valuation. Peer-median analysis references the five-company comparable set (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Castelion at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M), yielding a median valuation of $1.0B.

The triangulated range spans $22M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $513M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Alpine Eagle's technical differentiation and market traction relative to a peer set exhibiting substantial valuation heterogeneity. The stage-progression method produces a floor estimate, while peer multiples suggest substantially higher fair value if Alpine Eagle's capabilities align with more established Seed-stage defense peers. Resolution of technical risk and near-term revenue trajectory would be critical to narrowing this range.
